thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: geo-dns-health check failed for api.redwood.ai — spike in DNS NXDOMAINs and 502s in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. PagerDuty: pd-8791.

sre_lee: seeing it in Grafana — DNS error rate jumping at 15:03 UTC, 40% of requests returning SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN to our probes.

oncall-sre: paging in case netops needs to triage upstream resolver. I'm taking lead for now.

netops_jordan: ping — I'm on it. quick check: Cloudflare edge query rates look normal, but Route53 health checks show slow propagation for some records. Could be stale NS glue at certain resolvers.

support-anya: customer reports: multiple customers in west coast seeing 502s and unable to reach dashboards. Escalated tickets ramping. snippets: "api.redwood.ai failed to resolve".

eng-runtime-max: any rollout or infra change in last hour? no deployments on runtime, only monitoring config change at 14:50.

sre_lee: running quick dig from probe fleet:
```
dig +short @1.1.1.1 api.redwood.ai A
; some probes -> 13.52.10.11
; other probes -> ;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached
```
Some resolvers return A, others NXDOMAIN.

netops_jordan: looks like split answers from Cloudflare worker + Route53 TTL mismatch. Our GeoDNS config had a recent change to weighted routing last night — TTL still 3600. If some resolvers cached older delegation, they might be hitting a dead path.

oncall-sre: impact: P1 customer-facing. Mitigation plan: 1) lower TTL on authoritative to 60s if possible, 2) enable Route53-only fallback routing (force authoritative answers to Route53 endpoints), 3) open ticket with Cloudflare for resolver anomalies.

product-zoe: confirm customer comms: we should send a short "partial outage affecting west coast; engineers investigating" note in status page.

support-anya: drafted: "We are investigating a DNS issue affecting some US and EU users. Traffic may intermittently fail to resolve api.redwood.ai. Engineers are working on mitigation." Want to post after triage step 1.

netops_jordan: I'll make a config change to GeoDNS to pick Route53 fallback. Doing a dry-run:
```
# runbook snippet
terraform plan -target=module.geodns.route53_fallback
terraform apply -target=module.geodns.route53_fallback -auto-approve
```
Applying now — expecting propagation within ~30s-2m for our control plane, but external resolvers TTLs vary.

eng-runtime-max: enabling additional health check fallback in the runtime so requests will attempt direct IPs if DNS fails. Patch pushed to canary nodes.

sre_lee: netops change confirmed in console: Route53 fallback set to ON at 15:09:10 UTC. Rolling.

incident-bot: Automation: geo-dns policy updated by netops_jordan at 15:09:12 UTC — fallback=route53-only.

support-anya: posting status: "Investigating: partial DNS resolution failures for api.redwood.ai affecting US-west and EU-west. Mitigation in progress." Posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents at 15:10 UTC.

product-zoe: +1. Keep customers updated every 30 minutes.

oncall-sre: run some post-change probes. lee, paste probe diffs.

sre_lee: probes: before -> 38% errors from us-west probes; after -> 9% errors and gradually falling. More specifics:
```
us-west-1 probes: error rate 41% -> 8% (15:14)
eu-west-1 probes: error rate 29% -> 12% (15:14)
```
Some long-tailed resolvers still serving NXDOMAIN due to cached delegation.

netops_jordan: opened Cloudflare support ticket 847312 and routed to their resolver team, included dig traces and example resolver IPs. Also flagged Route53 delegation TTL mismatch with DNS provider contact.

eng-runtime-max: canary nodes show direct-IP fallback successful for ~97% of traffic; will roll to prod in 10m.

support-anya: incoming threads from impacted enterprise customer asking for ETA. Any estimate?

oncall-sre: estimate: mitigation reduces impact to low within 10-20 minutes, full global convergence depends on external resolver caches (up to TTL), but fallbacks should keep product usable. Tell customers 30-60m conservative.

product-zoe: ok, post update that mitigation is in place and we're monitoring; ETA 30-60m for more complete recovery.

netops_jordan: additional step: lowering authoritative TTL from 3600 -> 60 in case we need further reroutes. Doing it now via Route53 console.

incident-bot: Change recorded: route53 zone api.redwood.ai TTL changed 3600 -> 60 by netops_jordan at 15:22:03 UTC.

sre_lee: watching metrics — error rates continue to decline. Customer impact tickets still trickling in but severity reduced.

eng-runtime-max: rolled runtime fallback to prod at 15:25. Observability shows fewer 502/503 from app-facing services.

support-anya: sent update to enterprise customers with conservative ETA 45m and contact for live updates.

netops_jordan: Cloudflare replied: their edge resolvers saw anomalous delegation churn in specific ISP caches; they're investigating. They confirmed our fallback adoption looks normal.

oncall-sre: summary so far: cause likely GeoDNS/edge-delegation mismatch + long TTLs causing split-brain answers at public resolvers. Primary mitigations: enable Route53-only fallback, lower TTL, enable runtime direct-IP fallback. All three applied. Impact substantially reduced.

product-zoe: agree we should open a follow-up postmortem to capture root cause, timeline, and long-term fixes (automated TTL ramp-down on routing changes, add sanity checks when changing weights).

support-anya: closing immediate high-severity customer bridge; will keep watching for regressions.

eng-runtime-max: monitoring for 30m then we'll transition to SEV-2 monitoring channel.

incident-bot: Incident pd-8791 marked as mitigated at 15:48:45 UTC by oncall-sre.

sre_lee: moving to postmortem draft. I'll collect logs and timeline. netops_jordan, plz paste Terraform diffs and ticket IDs for Cloudflare + Route53.

netops_jordan: Cloudflare ticket 847312; Route53 support case r53-66231; terraform diff: `+ route53_fallback = true`, `- geodns_ttl = 3600 -> 60`. Pushing to ops-runbooks/incidents/5043210000 for record.

product-zoe: thanks all. I'll schedule a retro tomorrow to decide long-term safeguards.

support-anya: final: status page update at 15:50 UTC: "Mitigated — partial DNS resolution issues were mitigated via routing fallbacks and TTL changes. Monitoring continues."

oncall-sre: thread closed but keep alerts unmuted for 2h. Good job team. :clap:
